integrity: The universal statement is proved analytically. The accompanying finite computation checks identities and representative inequalities only and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The explicit coefficient is not claimed sharp in dimension or angle.
The theorem controls orientation mass and does not use spatial placement of barrier pieces.
The theorem does not by itself improve the minimum-area lower bound for barriers of the cube.
title: Linear off-axis orientation stability for weak barriers of the unit cube
